issues: The translation leaves out "presentation" (발표) and "by," so it only says "at Bad Honnef 2007, C.F." The segment also appears to have been cut off after "C.F.", so the translation can't read as a complete Korean phrase (e.g., "C.F. Bolz가 `Bad Honnef 2007`_\ 에서 한 발표").

issues: The translation reads naturally, but it adds "발표한 자료" (presentation material), which the terse source fragment doesn't state; this is reasonable only if the surrounding context is a list of talks.

segments.source: `PyPy's VM Approach`_ talk, given by Armin Rigo at the Dynamic Languages Symposium at OOPSLA'06 (Portland OR), and by Samuele Pedroni at Intel Hillsboro (OR)  (October).
segments.translation: `PyPy's VM Approach`_ 강연은 Armin Rigo가 OOPSLA'06(오리건주 포틀랜드)의 Dynamic Languages Symposium에서, Samuele Pedroni가 Intel Hillsboro(오리건주)에서(10월) 진행했습니다.

segments.source: The talk presents the paper `PyPy's approach to virtual machine construction`_ accepted for the symposium.
segments.translation: 이 강연은 해당 심포지엄에 채택된 논문 `PyPy's approach to virtual machine construction`_\ 을 소개합니다.

segments.source: `PyPy Status`_ talk, given by Samuele Pedroni at the Vancouner Python Workshop 2006 (August).
segments.translation: Samuele Pedroni가 2006년 8월 밴쿠버 Python 워크숍 2006(Vancouner Python Workshop 2006)에서 진행한 `PyPy Status`_ 발표입니다.
issues: The meaning is accurate and the sentence reads naturally, but "2006" appears twice ("2006년 8월 … 워크숍 2006"), and the parenthetical copies the source's "Vancouner" typo when "밴쿠버 Python 워크숍 2006(8월)" would read more cleanly.

segments.source: `Trouble in Paradise`_: the Open Source Project PyPy, EU-funding and Agile Practices talk, by Bea During at Agile 2006 (experience report).
segments.translation: `Trouble in Paradise`_: 오픈 소스 프로젝트 PyPy, EU 자금 지원과 애자일 실천법에 관한 발표로, Bea During이 Agile 2006에서 발표했습니다(경험 보고서).
issues: The meaning, title reference and names are all correct, but "발표로, … 발표했습니다" repeats "발표", so a smoother version would be "…에 관한 발표로, Bea During이 Agile 2006에서 진행했습니다(경험 보고)."

segments.source: `Sprint Driven Development`_, Agile Methodologies in a Distributed Open Source Project (PyPy) talk, by Bea During at XP 2006 (experience report).
segments.translation: `Sprint Driven Development`_, 분산 오픈 소스 프로젝트(PyPy)의 애자일 방법론에 관한 강연, Bea During, XP 2006(경험 보고).

segments.source: `Kill -1`_: process refactoring in the PyPy project talk, by Bea During at the Agile track/Europython 2006.
segments.translation: `Kill -1`_: PyPy 프로젝트의 프로세스 리팩터링에 관한 발표, Bea During, Agile 트랙/Europython 2006.

segments.source: `What can PyPy do for you`_, by Armin Rigo and Carl Friedrich Bolz given at EuroPython 2006.
segments.translation: `What can PyPy do for you`_, Armin Rigo와 Carl Friedrich Bolz가 EuroPython 2006에서 발표했습니다.
issues: The meaning is accurate and the RST link is kept, but the source is a noun-phrase list entry and the translation turns it into a full sentence ending in "발표했습니다", which reads awkwardly after the title and comma; a noun-phrase form like "Armin Rigo와 Carl Friedrich Bolz가 EuroPython 2006에서 발표한 `What can PyPy do for you`_" would read more naturally.

segments.source: The talk describes practical usecases of PyPy.
segments.translation: 이 강연에서는 PyPy의 실용적인 사용 사례를 설명합니다.

segments.source: `PyPy 3000`_, a purely implementation-centered lightning talk at EuroPython 2006, given by Armin Rigo and Holger Krekel.
segments.translation: `PyPy 3000`_\ 은 EuroPython 2006에서 Armin Rigo와 Holger Krekel이 발표한, 순전히 구현에 초점을 맞춘 라이트닝 토크입니다.

segments.source: `PyPy introduction at EuroPython 2006`_, given by Michael Hudson, also stating the status of the project.
segments.translation: Michael Hudson이 발표한 `PyPy introduction at EuroPython 2006`_\ 으로, 프로젝트의 현황도 함께 다룹니다.

segments.source: Very similar to the EuroPython intro talk (but somewhat older) is the `PyPy intro`_ talk, given by Michael Hudson at ACCU 2006 (April)
segments.translation: EuroPython 소개 발표와 매우 비슷한(다만 조금 더 오래된) 발표로는 Michael Hudson이 ACCU 2006(4월)에서 한 `PyPy intro`_ 발표가 있습니다.

segments.source: `PyPy development method`_ talk, given by Bea During and Holger Krekel at Pycon2006
segments.translation: Bea During과 Holger Krekel이 Pycon2006에서 발표한 `PyPy development method`_ 강연

segments.source: `PyPy - the new Python implementation on the block`_, given by Carl Friedrich Bolz and Holger Krekel at the 22nd Chaos Communication Conference in Berlin, Dec. 2005.
segments.translation: `PyPy - the new Python implementation on the block`_, 2005년 12월 베를린에서 열린 제22회 Chaos Communication Conference에서 Carl Friedrich Bolz와 Holger Krekel이 발표했습니다.

segments.source: `Open Source, EU-Funding and Agile Methods`_, given by Holger Krekel and Bea During at the 22nd Chaos Communication Conference in Berlin, Dec. 2005
segments.translation: Holger Krekel과 Bea During이 2005년 12월 베를린에서 열린 제22회 Chaos Communication Conference에서 발표한 `Open Source, EU-Funding and Agile Methods`_

segments.source: `Sprinting the PyPy way`_, an overview about our sprint methodology, given by Bea During during EuroPython 2005. (More PyPy talks were given, but are not present in detail.)
segments.translation: `Sprinting the PyPy way`_\ 는 EuroPython 2005에서 Bea During이 발표한 저희 스프린트 방법론에 대한 개요입니다. (그 밖에도 여러 PyPy 발표가 있었지만, 여기에 자세히 싣지는 않았습니다.)

segments.source: `PyCon 2005`_ animated slices, mostly reporting on the translator status.
segments.translation: `PyCon 2005`_ 애니메이션 슬라이드로, 주로 변환기의 현황을 보고합니다.
issues: The meaning comes through, and rendering "slices" as 슬라이드 correctly fixes what is likely a typo in the source, but there are two small problems: in the PyPy context "translator" means the RPython translation toolchain, so 번역기 is the usual term rather than 변환기, and the "슬라이드로, …보고합니다" construction reads a little awkwardly because it has no subject.

segments.source: `py lib slides`_ from the py lib talk at PyCon 2005 (py is used as a support/testing library for PyPy).
segments.translation: PyCon 2005의 py lib 발표에서 사용된 `py lib slides`_\ 입니다(py는 PyPy의 지원/테스트 라이브러리로 사용됩니다).

segments.source: `EU funding for FOSS`_ talk on Chaos Communication Conference in Berlin, Dec 2004.
segments.translation: 2004년 12월 베를린에서 열린 Chaos Communication Conference의 `EU funding for FOSS`_ 발표입니다.

segments.source: oscon2003-paper_ an early paper presented at Oscon 2003 describing what the PyPy project is about and why you should care.
segments.translation: oscon2003-paper_ Oscon 2003에서 발표된 초기 논문으로, PyPy 프로젝트가 무엇에 관한 것인지와 왜 관심을 가져야 하는지를 설명합니다.

segments.source: `Architecture introduction slides`_ a mostly up-to-date introduction for the Amsterdam PyPy-Sprint Dec 2003.
segments.translation: `Architecture introduction slides`_\ 는 2003년 12월 암스테르담 PyPy 스프린트를 위해 준비된 소개 자료로, 내용이 대부분 최신 상태입니다.

segments.source: TraceMonkey_ is using a tracing JIT, similar to the tracing JITs generated by our (in-progress) JIT generator.
segments.translation: TraceMonkey_\ 는 트레이싱 JIT를 사용하며, 이는 저희의 (개발 중인) JIT 생성기가 생성하는 트레이싱 JIT와 유사합니다.

segments.source: Dynamo_ showcased `transparent dynamic optimization`_ generating an optimized version of a binary program at runtime.
segments.translation: Dynamo_\ 는 런타임에 바이너리 프로그램의 최적화된 버전을 생성하는 `transparent dynamic optimization`_\ 을 선보였습니다.

segments.source: Tailoring Dynamo_ to interpreter implementations and challenges - Gregory Sullivan et. al., `Dynamic Native Optimization of Native Interpreters`_.
segments.translation: 인터프리터 구현에 맞춘 Dynamo_ 조정 방법과 과제 - Gregory Sullivan 외, `Dynamic Native Optimization of Native Interpreters`_.

segments.source: Stackless_ is a recursion-free version of Python.
segments.translation: Stackless_\ 는 재귀를 사용하지 않는 Python 버전입니다.

segments.source: Psyco_ is a just-in-time specializer for Python.
segments.translation: Psyco_\ 는 Python을 위한 JIT(just-in-time) 특수화기입니다.

segments.source: JikesRVM_ a research dynamic optimizing Java VM written in Java.
segments.translation: JikesRVM_\ 는 Java로 작성된 연구용 동적 최적화 Java VM입니다.

segments.source: `Squeak`_ is a Smalltalk-80 implementation written in Smalltalk, being used in `Croquet`_, an experimental distributed multi-user/multi-programmer virtual world.
segments.translation: `Squeak`_\ 은 Smalltalk로 작성된 Smalltalk-80 구현체로, 실험적인 분산 다중 사용자/다중 프로그래머 가상 세계인 `Croquet`_\ 에서 사용되고 있습니다.

segments.source: `LLVM`_ the low level virtual machine project.
segments.translation: `LLVM`_\ 은 저수준 가상 머신(low level virtual machine) 프로젝트입니다.

segments.source: `CLR under the hood`_ (powerpoint, works with open office) gives a good introduction to the underlying models of Microsoft's Common Language Runtime, the Intermediate Language, JIT and GC issues.
segments.translation: `CLR under the hood`_ (파워포인트 자료이며 오픈 오피스에서도 열립니다)는 Microsoft 공용 언어 런타임(Common Language Runtime)과 중간 언어(Intermediate Language)의 기반 모델, 그리고 JIT 및 GC 관련 문제를 잘 소개합니다.

segments.source: spyweb translates Python programs to Scheme. (site unavailable)
segments.translation: spyweb은 Python 프로그램을 Scheme으로 변환합니다. (사이트 접속 불가)

segments.source: Jython_ is a Python implementation in Java.
segments.translation: Jython_\ 은 Java로 작성된 Python 구현체입니다.

segments.source: IronPython_ a new Python implementation compiling Python into Microsoft's Common Language Runtime (CLR) Intermediate Language (IL).
segments.translation: IronPython_\ 은 Python을 Microsoft의 공용 언어 런타임(Common Language Runtime, CLR) 중간 언어(Intermediate Language, IL)로 컴파일하는 새로운 Python 구현체입니다.

issues: The translation is natural and keeps the RST markup correct (`Tunes_\ 도` attaches the particle properly), but "도" adds an "also" that isn't in the source; "Tunes_\ 는" or "Tunes_\ 가" would be more faithful unless the surrounding text implies a comparison.

segments.source: The web site changed a lot, but a snapshot of the `old Tunes Wiki`_ is available; browsing through it is a lot of fun.
segments.translation: 웹 사이트는 많이 바뀌었지만 `old Tunes Wiki`_\ 의 스냅숏을 볼 수 있으며, 이를 둘러보는 것은 무척 재미있습니다.
